beats.title: Preflight Check
beats.narration: Mission Control is ready. Spell the word to clear the pad for launch.

beats.title: Countdown
beats.narration: T-minus... engines humming. Spell true and the clock keeps ticking.

beats.title: Liftoff
beats.narration: Ignition! The rocket climbs. A correct spelling keeps the climb steady.

beats.title: Earth Orbit
beats.narration: You're circling the blue marble. Spell to hold your course.

beats.title: Coast to the Moon
beats.narration: Long quiet stretch through the dark. One good word at a time.

beats.title: Lunar Approach
beats.narration: The Moon fills the window. Spell carefully on final approach.

beats.title: Touchdown
beats.narration: Contact light! Soft landing on dusty ground.

beats.title: Flag and Explore
beats.narration: Boots on regolith. Plant the flag with a solid spelling.

beats.title: Sample Collection
beats.narration: Scoop rocks for the trip home. Spell to fill the bag.

beats.title: Return Ascent
beats.narration: Ascent stage firing. Leave the Moon behind.

beats.title: Leave Lunar Orbit
beats.narration: Trans-Earth injection. Point home and spell true.

beats.title: Re-entry
beats.narration: Atmosphere ahead. Heat shield glowing. Hold the spelling line!

beats.title: Splashdown
beats.narration: Chutes open. Splash! The ocean catches you.

beats.title: Navy Recovery
beats.narration: A recovery ship steams in. Spell to climb aboard.

beats.title: Welcome Home
beats.narration: One last word and the mission is in the history books.

completed.narration: Mission complete! Splashdown secured, the Navy has the crew, and you spelled your way to the Moon and back.

failed.narration: You didn't quite make it. Too many missed spellings aborted the mission. Try again, astronaut.
